correctness.rationale: For every \(m,n\ge3\), proper three-block partitions split exactly one bipartition side, and deletion adjacency identifies each branch with the simple antipodal cube quotient. Interbranch edges are impossible except through the common two-colour partition. The factors have spanning 2-connected cubes, hence unique cut vertex. Path lifting gives full geodesic counts; even Walsh-character Laplacian spectrum and Kirchhoff give exact spanning-tree factor. All critical finite cases independently reproduced from raw Bell partitions and exact integer determinants in artifacts/verify.py.
